messages:
Ashwin R: ran FP8 enablement sweep for new-mono-70B on H100/L40S. Short summary: H100 FP8 path passes perf targets but we observed token-level saturation on long-context few-shot prompts; L40S shows earlier fallback to FP16 with quality divergence.
Marta L: can you paste the minimal repro and config?
Ashwin R: repro below — short prompt + 8 shots (≈2k tokens). Config:
```json
{"model":"new-mono-70b","quant":"fp8","hardware":"h100","tiling":"auto","kv_cache":true,"batch_size":1,"seq_len":2048}
```
Ashwin R: metrics from eval harness (small probe): LAMBADA PPLs — H100 FP16 baseline 9.2, H100 FP8 9.6 (+4.3%), L40S FP8 (soft-fallback mix) 10.8. Also saw repetition increase on long prompts: rep-5 rate up ~3%.
Kevin C: interesting — did you see NaNs or just saturation? logs?
Ashwin R: no NaNs, but kernel logs show activation saturation warnings and a soft-fallback path kicking in for some matmuls. snippet:
```text
WARN: activation_max ~ 1.2e4 exceeds scaling threshold, invoking soft-fallback to FP16 for matmul
```
Sophie: could be activation-scale mismatch for fused GELU/attention on L40S. We merged a scale-heuristic tweak last week that might interact with tiling.
Marta L: for a quick canary let's gate FP8 attention on sequences >1024 and expose a fallback mode flag (soft/abort). Can we try that and run a 200-sample eval?
Kevin C: I'll add runtime flag REDWOOD_FP8_FALLBACK={soft|abort} and per-kernel gating. Launching canary in eu-west-1 now.
ci-bot: Canary deploy for experiment/fp8-fallback-toggles succeeded — https://ci.redwood/exp/5678 :white_check_mark:
Ashwin R: quick results: abort mode (overflow aborts and surface error) reduces PPL on H100 to 9.3 (closer to FP16) but latency increases ~6% due to extra checks. L40S still shows higher PPL — likely kernel tiling + scale mismatch.
Sophie: please attach kernel dumps and per-layer activation histograms. I want to rule out per-op dtype promotion bugs on L40S kernels.
Marta L: filing a ticket for tracking: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-4321 — assign to eng-runtime and eng-ml, add logs. Tag me. :eyes: 
Kevin C: ack, patch pushed to canary branch and 1k-sample run kicked off; will post full numbers later.
Ashwin R: short-term plan: disable FP8 attention on L40S for model onboarding until kernel fix; keep H100 FP8 enabled but with fallback=abort on overflow. We'll monitor regression alerts.
Sophie: also adding a micro-benchmark to onboarding harness that emits activation distribution summaries and a small synthetic long-context suite so future onboarding fails fast.
Marta L: thanks everyone — good triage. Follow-up sync Thurs 11am PST.
